answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed whenever its grades diverge from jury consensus. Honest work returns the bond; fraud burns it. A sybil swarm must fund one stake per fake identity, so forging N identities costs N bonds up front — the design offers no harbor for a cheap majority. Reputation acts as a prism, splitting raw stake into weighted influence, while repeated slashing erodes an attacker like water dissolving karst. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count; honest agents pay nothing net.
